23.issue_summary: App requests precise location (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) for concert search when features only require approximate location (coarse city-level access).
23.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml Line 15 requests ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and LocationManager.kt Line 19 uses Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY, despite MainViewModel+Concerts.kt Line 37 using location solely to search concerts within a 50-mile radius (range=50mi).
23.recommendation: Downgrade Manifest to ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION to respect the minimum scope mandate.

24.issue_summary: App purpose (Mave) does not inherently imply location tracking, yet foreground location access is performed without a prominent disclosure.
24.evidence: LocationManager.kt Line 18 retrieves device location via FusedLocationProviderClient for concert discovery without executing an in-app prominent disclosure dialog explaining location data collection.
24.recommendation: Implement a Prominent In-App Disclosure dialog explaining what location data is collected before requesting foreground permission.

27.issue_summary: App requests broad RECORD_AUDIO permission on Target SDK 37 for user-initiated vocal input and recording.
27.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml Line 13 declares RECORD_AUDIO and MainActivity.kt Line 278 requests RECORD_AUDIO runtime permission for occasional user-initiated voice commands triggered via chat-interface.ts Line 38 on Target SDK 37.
27.recommendation: Migrate to the Android Microphone Button API to process temporary audio securely.
